evidence_items.locator: Section 6.2, By Architecture & Type of Attention
evidence_items.explanation: Winoground found large human-model gaps across several vision-language model families on image-caption matching that depends on composition. The finding supports a broad weakness within the tested contemporary systems.

The COGS comparison supports a structural-generalization weakness in sequence-to-sequence models, including BART. Its successful compositional parsers and strong lexical results are material counterevidence to any universal claim that all AI systems lack compositional ability.

evidence_items.explanation: This research states the linguistic principle underlying the claim. Its older experimental findings are not used as outcome evidence for 2022 systems.
